title: Page<TrainingRun>
description: The pagination envelope of MOS-API-015 over TrainingRun, for table 10.2-B row R7. The envelope is written out here rather than referenced from a generic Page schema because MOS-API-015 says 'MUST be exactly' and closes the object: a generic envelope with an items array of anything would have to be open at the point where the requirement is closed. No total member, by MOS-API-016 -- counting is an unbounded scan and this table grows per run. Ordering is MOS-API-018's created_at DESC, id DESC and is not client-selectable, so there is no sort member either.

next_cursor.description: MOS-API-017: base64url of a JSON object carrying the sort key, the tie-break id and a fingerprint of the normalised filter set. Opaque; an SDK MUST NOT parse, construct or mutate it. MOS-API-015: null when has_more is false.
